hero.ability1: Offering to the Kami: At your Start of Turn, you may Discard a card from your Hand to gain 3 Lifeforce. If you do, cards cannot be added to your Hand outside your Draw Phase this turn.
hero.ability2: Kami's Favor: The first card you play from your Hand During your Turn with a cost of 3 or lower costs 1 less Lifeforce.
hero.ability3: Guidance of the Spirits: At your End of Turn, you may spend 1 Lifeforce to Summon a Minion with a Cost of 2 or less from your Deck or Graveyard.
hero.ability4: Embrace the Yin: During any Turn you may switch your active Hero to Abe No Seimei, Yin Aspect. You can only switch between Yin Aspect and Yang Aspect once During any Turn.

secondaryHero.ability1: Dual Vision: During your Draw Phase you may Spend 1 Lifeforce to Draw an additional card. If you do, you cannot use Sacrifce Card this Turn.
secondaryHero.ability2: Subjugating Presence: The first card you play from your Hand During your Turn with a cost of 4 or more costs 1 less Lifeforce.
secondaryHero.ability3: Way of the Diviner: At your End of Turn, look at the top three cards of your Deck. You may place them back in any order or Shuffle your Deck.
secondaryHero.ability4: Embrace the Yang: During any Turn you may switch your active Hero to Abe No Seimei, Yang Aspect. You can only switch between Yin Aspect and Yang Aspect once During any Turn.
